## Overview

LRP205 is the no-interaction companion to [LRP105](../lrp-rli-mech-105/). It keeps the same letter-sound mechanism, word-reading outcome, subject random intercept and nonword-decoding (NW) main effect, but sets `include_interaction=False`, so there is no letter-sound × NW `gamma_int` term.

The purpose is a nested comparison: LRP105 versus LRP205 asks whether the NW moderation improves predictive fit beyond the NW main effect (`compare_statistical_models.nw_moderation_loo_compare`). As in LRP105, NW is a mediator and heavily floored, so any signal is a descriptive, floor-limited adjusted association, never causal.

## Model

$$
\eta = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{phase}} + \beta_G G
  + f^L(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})
  + \gamma_{\text{mod}} z(\operatorname{logit}_* \text{NW}_{\text{post}})
  + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(W_{\text{pre}})
  + \gamma_A z(A) + \sum_c \gamma_c z(c) + u_{\text{child}}.
$$

The omitted term is the LRP105 interaction $\gamma_{\text{int}} z(\operatorname{logit}_* L_{\text{post}})\, z(\operatorname{logit}_* \text{NW}_{\text{post}})$.
